question: To which revilers of sacred principles must the teaching never be given?
premises: The teaching must not be given
Slanderers of Kula Bhairava are excluded
inference: The teaching must not be given to those who revile Śiva or Kula Bhairava
plain_english: O goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Śiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
